package.name: det_range
package.description: Tags det_ros detections (vision_msgs/Detection2DArray) of the front stereo right eye with a robust range from the Metoak hardware depth (mower_cameras/stereo_depth) and publishes /ai/det/detections_ranged plus the ranged centroids in base_link (PoseArray + PointCloud2 for the Nav2 local costmap).
